tiers.everyday: Great Tom is the big bell in Tom Tower at Christ Church, Oxford. It came from Osney Abbey and was recast in 1680.
tiers.student: Christ Church records the great bell as originally from Osney Abbey, recast in 1680 by Christopher Hodson and hung in Tom Tower. Two bells of about 1410 by John Bird survive in the cathedral ring. Mass [UNKNOWN] in the official page.
